basis: Defined symptomatic phenotype includes spinal, neurodevelopmental and pigmentary abnormalities; most mosaics are normal. Cardiac and renal anomalies are occasional; constipation alone is insufficient.
Defective respiratory ciliary clearance causes chronic airway disease; middle-ear inflammation occurs in 3/4 patients.
Congenital anterior segment dysgenesis involving the cornea and iris.
Congenital hand and foot reduction defects affect bones, joints, muscles, tendons and ligaments; cutaneous webbing is part of the limb malformation.
PLP1-related CNS hypomyelinating disease in manifesting female carriers; urinary abnormalities are occasional, below 30%.
Benign ovarian epithelial and stromal neoplasm; reproductive location without a defining endocrine disorder.
Carcinoma arising in the oesophagus.
Telomere syndrome defined by pulmonary disease and/or marrow failure. Premature graying in 3/5 does not establish skin damage; hepatic abnormalities occur in 1/5.
Defined by microcephaly and limb malformations; microcephaly occurs in 29/29 and intellectual disability/developmental delay in 15/29.
Inherited lysine transport disorder involving intestinal absorption and renal tubular reabsorption; intellectual disability frequency is unspecified, so neurologic involvement is not established.
Skeletal dysplasia involving vertebrae, epiphyses and metaphyses, with osteoporosis and joint degeneration.
Severe congenital cerebral malformation with profound motor and intellectual impairment.
Cerebellar hypoplasia and ataxia define the disease; muscle atrophy occurs in 3/5 and pes planus in 5/5. Strabismus/nystagmus do not establish intrinsic eye damage.
Intrinsic eosinophil granule and peroxidase abnormality; clinically significant immunodeficiency is not established.
Histologic subtype of synovial sarcoma, a mesenchymal soft-tissue malignancy.
Peroxisomal plasmalogen synthesis disorder classified as chondrodysplasia punctata; severe neurologic disease in 3/3 and cataracts in 2/3.
Persistent ventricular arrhythmia with frequent cardiac dysfunction; all defining manifestations are cardiovascular.
Congenital anomalous coronary origin causing myocardial ischaemia, ventricular failure and mitral insufficiency.
Anti-MOG-associated immune-mediated inflammation and demyelination of the spinal cord; optic neuritis is a separate manifestation, not intrinsic to this concept.
Carcinoma of the urethra, included in the urinary tract axis.
Inherited thyroid hormone synthesis defect causing congenital hypothyroidism; frequency of permanent neurologic impairment is not established.
Umbrella for disorders of skeletal muscle relaxation; multisystem damage in myotonic dystrophy cannot be generalized across all subtypes.
Congenital absence of right ventricular myocardium causes ventricular dysfunction and heart failure; pleural effusion is occasional.
Obstetric disorder of amniotic fluid volume; fetal renal disease and pulmonary hypoplasia are not defining organ damage across this umbrella.
Persistent or reactivated rubella infection causes chronic progressive inflammation and damage of the brain.
